name: Razzeric's Tweaking
summary: On the Shimmering Flats, Razzeric adds personal modifications to racers once Pozzik has finished with them. A seaforium booster ordered from Shreev in Gadgetzan was on a zeppelin that Razzeric hears crashed in Dustwallow Marsh, and Razzeric wants it brought back.

sections.title: More Juice
sections.body: Razzeric grants that Pozzik is a great mechanic, but thinks Pozzik too wary of loading on firepower and hanging on for the ride. Once Pozzik is done with a racer, Razzeric spends time making personal changes: loosening the controls, removing frame sections and piling on power. A seaforium booster was ordered from Shreev at the Gizmorium in Gadgetzan, but the zeppelin carrying it crashed in Dustwallow Marsh, by Razzeric's account. The booster is needed back on the Shimmering Flats, since showing up at the track without that extra kick would be a travesty.

sections.title: Strapped to the Racer
sections.body: Razzeric raves over the booster: a full fifteen pounds of seaforium. Strapped to the side of a racer, it should carry Razzeric through the circuit at such speed that the gnomes are beaten twice over.

faq.answer: Razzeric is a racer on the Shimmering Flats who makes personal changes to racers after Pozzik finishes with them.

faq.q: Where did the booster come from?
faq.answer: Razzeric ordered it from Shreev at Gadgetzan's Gizmorium.

faq.q: Where is the seaforium booster now?
faq.answer: Razzeric says the zeppelin carrying it crashed in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Why does Razzeric want the booster?
faq.answer: Razzeric wants more power than Pozzik is willing to load on, and thinks facing the track without that extra kick would be a travesty.
